summary: fix(settings): let existing accounts with local-part-dot emails sign in
description:
Because:
* Sign-in rejected existing accounts whose email fails isEmail only on
  local-part dots (e.g. first.last.@gmail.com), locking those users out

This commit:
* Adds isSigninEmail: isEmail, or isEmailValid plus isEmail without local-part dots
* Uses it in the email-first gate, SigninQueryParams and IsEmailOrEmpty
* Keeps strict isEmail for new accounts on email-first and Signin
* Adds validator, query-param model and container tests

Closes #FXA-15134
